text: Could you please make it easier for customers who have appointments at 4:00 or 4:30? I mean, can I be 10 minutes late? I was driving as fast as I could, but traffic was terrible. After only 10 minutes, they didn't let me see the doctor. I feel very tired and stressed out trying to make it on time. I'd like to see them for even 20 minutes longer. The last time, I was in such a hurry that we almost bumped into each other on the road. Not only did the child miss the appointment, but I also had to clear the traffic. I feel so sorry for my child who didn't get to see the doctor today. He really wanted to see the doctor because he's gotten much better after receiving treatment here. So I told him that next time is fine, my child. Let's just say that we've arrived at the clinic and it's okay if we don't go in. I'll just take him to the cafe to buy some drinks instead. Thank you so much to the clinic. I think I'll consider finding a more convenient place from now on.
